detail.description:
Tricky Puzzle 2 is here. A brand new brain teaser game filled with tricky riddles and unexpected solutions.

Are you smart enough to solve them all? Think outside the box, break the rules, and challenge your imagination.

🧠 Features

Hundreds of tricky puzzles and brain teasers
Unexpected answers that will surprise you
Fun, creative, and sometimes absurd challenges
Easy to play but hard to master

🎯 Why you will love it

Test your IQ and logic skills
Train your brain in a fun way
Enjoy hilario
